metadata.description:
Cattails Golf Club 18-Hole Championship public golf course designed by PGA Professional John R. Williams and opened in 1991.  The course has hosted The Michigan Amateur Qualifier, LPGA Futures Tour, Amateur Shooters Tour, Elite Company and Charity Events.
Built on a former 160 acre horse farm, the course embodies the natural beauty of the South Lyon area.  The course successfully integrates the many acres of wetlands and hardwood forest native area.  The front nine travels through and around creeks and wetlands.  The back nine is cut through a hard wood forest with a few wetland areas to navigate.  
Four sets of tees enable golfers to experience the course at their own level of challenges from 4974 yards to 6436 yards. 
The 5,000 square-foot clubhouse features an elegant setting with a covered patio overlooking the 9th green. Cattails offers a level of superior personal service and outstanding course conditions and amenities.

metadata.description: Want to experience an "up north" golf course with the convenience of a Metro Detroit location? Rattle Run Golf Course is the answer for you! Built on 178 acres in Southwestern St. Clair County, with easy access off 1-94 from Detroit, this  18-hole course is back on top as one of the finest public golf courses in the United States. Golf Digest ranked Rattle Run as one of the top 75 courses in the United States. Nestled among hardwoods, the golfer will experience the feeling of being in "Northern Michigan," as wildlife abounds in the rivers, ponds, and vegetation throughout the course. Golfers are struck by the beauty of the tree-lined fairways. After teeing off, golfers get a firsthand look at the 78 bunkers and water hazards which majestically wind their way through 15 of the 18 holes. It pays to be in the fairway. The rolling and open course has strategically placed trees that really come into play on second shots. Dramatic elevation changes are reminiscent of the top Northern Michigan course.

metadata.description:
Welcome to Thousand Oaks Golf Club, one of Michigan's premier golf destinations. Golf Digest has rated this Rees Jones  signature course "4 ½ stars Places to Play" and one of the 25 best golf courses in Michigan.

This stunning piece of property will give you the feeling of a classic Northern Michigan-style golf course, located just minutes from downtown Grand Rapids. Thousand Oaks is designed to provide a challenging test of golf, while accommodating golfers of all skill levels. With four sets of tee markers on each hole, the course can play anywhere from 5,328 to 7,128 yards. You are promised not only to have a memorable golfing experience, but also the opportunity to take in great sights, sounds, and animal life found at Thousand Oaks Golf Club.
